Definition: from G3089; a loosening, i.e. (specially), divorce:--to be loosed.
BiblicalUsage: The word names a loosening, and Paul uses it for the bond of marriage: if a man is loosed from a wife, he is not to seek one. It is the one place the word stands, and it speaks of release from a bond.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that loosening is never light in Scripture, because bonds are made before God and only God unties what He has joined.
